name: cRZString::DeletingDestruct (slot 33, the vector deleting destructor)
notes: Lane GY. Hooked (MemberAddress). Bit 1: a new[] block (count dword before this): every element destroyed last first (the original runs `eh vector destructor iterator` 0x824e6f with the destructor 0x141193; ours calls our Destruct), with bit 0 the block freed (0x825401, operator delete[](void *, size_t): the size is ignored, it frees), returns the block; else Destruct, operator delete(this, 0x20) with bit 0, returns this. Difftest cRZString_DeletingDestruct: 4000 cases, single short / long strings and blocks of 0-5, both flag bits and junk in the others; return value as an offset, frees (which block, in order, sizes) and every byte left behind (pointer bytes 1-3 of a freed long buffer excepted: the destructor writes only the terminator). Mutants: elements first to last, last element skipped, block returned as this, the array branch taken on bits 0|1, the array block freed on bits 0|1, the single string freed on any flag: killed; the size passed to delete[] dropped the cookie: survived, equivalent (0x825401 pushes only the pointer to operator delete[](void *) 0x6c4b50, which jumps to free). Byte match 0.375 (the EH frame of the compiler's vector iterator call): difftest. Release (ours) reaches it through the vtable.
